t: Hive bees, like the vanilla bee, lives in hives and produce honey and resources. They have to live in advanced hives to produce resource combs. Most hive bees are bred from solitary bees and other hive bees but some are made by giving a specific item to a bee. All bee recipes can be found in JEI.
蜂巢蜜蜂和原版蜜蜂一样住在蜂箱里，产出蜂蜜与各种资源。要产资源蜜脾，它们必须住在高级蜂箱中。多数蜂巢蜜蜂由独居蜜蜂与其他蜂巢蜜蜂繁殖而来，也有一些是给某只蜜蜂特定物品变来的。全部繁殖配方都能在 JEI 里查到。

Each hive bee has it's own particular flower need in order to produce resources. For instance, an Iron Bee needs something made of iron nearby it's hive. All flowering requirements can be found with JEI.
每种蜂巢蜜蜂产资源时都有各自要求的「花」。比如铁蜜蜂需要蜂箱附近有铁质的东西。全部授粉需求都能在 JEI 里查到。
